source_of_truth: PR #1 cleanup preserved as legacy; new vertical slice independent.
semantics: Status is scoped. present means implemented with stated tests, not universally validated or state of the art.

acceptance_policies.gate_1: Controlled implementation and ablation required before promotion.
acceptance_policies.gate_2: Preserved only for characterization; do not inherit into new engine.
acceptance_policies.gate_3: Retire or introduce a separately versioned implementation; never silently repurpose.
acceptance_policies.gate_4: Invariant tests pass; benchmark scope is explicitly limited.
acceptance_policies.gate_5: Matched cooling-only and gain-zero ablations needed for causal performance claims.

features.description: Joint oblique soft trees with input-dependent attention; compatibility baseline.
Regression, binary, multiclass and multitarget output shapes.
Leaf L2, residual L1, temperature and diversity terms exist; semantics characterized.
Historical cosine, logarithmic, polynomial and exponential schedules retained, including known defects.
Legacy alpha changes a penalty, not routing, predictions or node count.
Legacy attention sees raw NaNs before tree-level handling.
Legacy measured validation state differs from post-hardening snapshot.
Legacy temperature is trainable and manually overwritten.
Legacy diversity performs another stochastic tree forward.
Legacy feature/tree dropout share one setting.
Legacy sigmoid initialization does not constrain later residual weights.
Historical cosine backoff reduces temperature on regression.
hardening_rate is not consumed by the legacy schedule.
temp_reg_weight does not weight the temperature objective.
use_hessian does not implement Newton fitting.
Analytic logistic gradients and Hessians; autograd agreement.
Float64 coupled soft-leaf Newton ridge solve, not independent hard-leaf updates.
One new candidate per stage; accepted tree parameters and temperatures remain frozen.
Backtracking on training logistic loss before accepting an additive stage.
Sample weights travel with minibatch indices and have scale-invariant normalization.
Weighted training-only imputation/scaling and explicit inf rejection.
Positive node temperature buffers; scheduling and optimizer ownership cannot conflict.
Declared hybrid CART initialization; separately named random alternative.
Explicit unit-curvature residual-fitting ablation.
Model selection returns the actually evaluated prefix, including intercept-only.
CPU data and score caches; minibatch device transfers.
Primitive/tensor checkpoint restores predictions, metrics, controller state.
Versioned hard binary model with preprocessing and tie convention.
fit/predict/probability/score and clone-compatible constructor.
Per-node reach, effective sample size, routing entropy and conditional label information.
Actual optimizer movement records cancelling oscillations as nonzero path length.
Bounded split histories remain independent of plasticity and policy.
Inference does not advance metrics or physical state.
Regression above a smoothed reference injects bounded charge once per observation.
Exact parallel-resistor discharge conserves released electrical energy as heat.
Separate exact linear or implicit radiative cooling; no below-ambient overshoot.
Only new candidate gates reheat; old boosting stages remain immutable.
Learned class/target-specific output and attention heads, preserving plain multiclass mode.
Optional one-v-rest auxiliary objectives; do not force one tree per class.
Regression, multiclass and multitarget stagewise objective abstractions.
Clearly labeled joint refinement after stagewise fitting.
Correct input-dependent trinary/n-ary routing, not common-shift softmax cancellation.
On-demand node allocation and physical removal without complete-tree preallocation.
Remove dead optimizer/metrics/controller state and register newly created parameters.
Distinct split/no-op structural gates; separately test coupled routing-temperature variant.
Define an actual functional identity or bypass before regularizing toward it.
Alternate candidate exploration, evidence gathering, consolidation/pruning and reopening.
Freeze/thaw nodes and subtrees by rolling schedule without removing predictions.
Schedule groups of trees/subtrees, not only synchronized depth layers.
Normalized depth weights with explicit direction of stronger penalties.
Learned split-specific beta allocation within each depth with anti-collapse safeguards.
Composable strategy interface and CustomPruning recreating named policies.
Depthwise, leafwise and hybrid growth informed by utility and traffic.
Nonlinear evidence threshold earns a detached persistent learned anchor.
Stress/yield law permits irreversible reference change beyond elastic regime.
Restoring constraint can lose integrity and release; not just anchor drift.
Accumulated plastic strain raises resistance to future deformation.
Heat optionally lowers effective yield threshold; coefficient zero disables.
Elapsed-time recovery without repeatedly subtracting total idle time.
Explicit final commitment phase with practically or exactly frozen anchors.
Persistence plus low path length and local utility; inactivity alone is insufficient.
Delayed split-specific deformation outcomes with matched probes/ablation and uncertainty.
One learner per run shares evidence across nodes and proposes bounded individual settings.
CPU-side proposal workers, bounded queues, versioning, safe-boundary application.
Importance, uncertainty, information flow, gate gradients, volatility, resistance and hardness.
Global reservoir plus per-tree/per-split allocation without energy double counting.
Seeded fixed per-tree heat capacities/cooling constants as explicit ablations.
Local gradient EMA independent of microbatch accumulation; memory cost measured.
Bounded optional energy-to-momentum mapping with stale-direction safeguards.
Derived passive RLC dynamics with separate resistor heat and inductor storage.
Rare seeded budgeted random perturbations; justify by controlled escape/adaptation experiments.
Optional separately ablated learning-rate coupling, never implicit equivalence.
Feature usage penalties, soft monotonicity and interaction constraints with executable semantics.
Explicit loss/derivative/metric contracts including weights and reductions.
Defined frequency units; all scheduled attributes reach actual consumers.
Optimizer, topology, RNG, queues and loader-position checkpoint for deterministic resume.
visualize_physical_state reads snapshots without causing state changes.
LightGBM, CatBoost, histogram boosting, MLP, NODE/GRANDE with equal-budget comparisons.
Measure real peak memory, freed node state, inference cost and structural churn.
None vs fixed anchor vs consolidation vs yield vs damage; retention/adaptation tests.
Boundedness/passivity arguments; distinguish controller stability from optimization convergence.
MDL/Bayesian structural penalties, PID/filtering, contextual bandits and evolutionary proposals.
Calling backward on disconnected Python metric floats does not learn controller parameters.
Process-global singleton/strong-reference node registry leaks runs and memory.
Zeroing dense weights is not physical deletion or sparse allocation.
Heating must not be interpreted as hesitation or freezing.
A nonsquare split vector cannot be regularized to a literal square identity without a new definition.
No performance/novelty rating or universal superiority claim without evidence.
